playkitCamera.frameGuide.en: The guide can appear over the camera preview. It is never included in the photo or used as proof.
playkitCamera.frameGuide.zh-Hans: 轮廓可以叠加在相机预览上，但不会写入照片，也不作为判定凭证。

playkitCamera.configGate.en: Camera overlay isn't available right now

playkitCamera.failedFallback.en: The camera did not open. You can still view the returned image below.
playkitCamera.failedFallback.zh-Hans: 相机未能打开，你仍可查看下方返回的图片。

playkitCamera.purpose.en: Use the camera for this view?

playkitCamera.overlayPurpose.en: Shows the task image over your rear-camera view. No photo or video is saved or uploaded, and this doesn't complete the task.
playkitCamera.overlayPurpose.zh-Hans: 将任务图片叠加在后置相机画面上。不会保存或上传照片、视频，也不会提交任务完成。

playkitCamera.screenSpaceOnly.zh-Hans: 屏幕叠图，并非空间 AR
